ask: A daily habit check-in log for my clients, instead of doing it over Telegram.
title: Habit check-in log
for_whom: a coach logging each client's daily habit check-ins
screens: one page: a form with client, date (default today), habit and done yes/no; a list of check-ins newest first; each client's current streak of done days
data: check-ins: client, date, habit, done; kept in the coach's own browser
done_when: adding a check-in shows it at the top of the list
three done days in a row show a streak of 3 for that client
check-ins are still there after a page reload
